verdict.statement: You cannot exit before the rules CAN change. Leaving takes at least 1 day, while the most notice any resolved authority route imposes is 1 day. The remaining unresolved routes can only make the real window SHORTER, never longer, so resolving them cannot change this conclusion — which is why a verdict is reachable here despite the window itself not being established.
